title: FH-Sampling: Frequency-aware Hypergraph-driven Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.20991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Imbalanced time-series data appears commonly in diverse applications, such as medical diagnosis. When trained on imbalanced data, classifiers tend to exhibit a bias toward the majority class, making it difficult to identify minority-class instances accurately, despite their critical importance. Sampling techniques have proven effective in rebalancing imbalanced data. However, existing interpolation-based oversampling methods typically rely on pairwise interpolation, limiting their ability to capture high-order inter-sample relationships, and their inherent smoothing effects tend to suppress high-frequency components, compromising spectral fidelity. Therefore, we propose a Frequency-aware Hypergraph-driven Oversampling method (FH-Sampling) for imbalanced time-series classification. translated_title: FH-Sampling：面向不平衡时间序列分类的频率感知超图驱动过采样方法
translated_abstract: 不平衡时间序列数据广泛存在于各类应用中，例如医学诊断。当在不平衡数据上进行训练时，分类器往往表现出对多数类的偏向，导致难以准确识别少数类实例，尽管少数类至关重要。采样技术已被证明能够有效地重新平衡不平衡数据。然而，现有的基于插值的过采样方法通常依赖成对插值，限制了其捕捉样本间高阶关系的能力，并且其固有的平滑效应往往会抑制高频成分，损害频谱保真度。因此，我们提出了一种面向不平衡时间序列分类的频率感知超图驱动过采样方法（FH-Sampling）。在FH-Sampling中，首先在原始时间序列空间中构建超图以捕捉复杂的高阶样本间关系，并且采样比例……
tldr: 该论文提出FH-Sampling方法，通过构建超图捕捉样本间高阶关系并进行频率感知的过采样，在保持频谱保真度的同时缓解不平衡时间序列分类中的多数类偏向问题。
en_tdlr: FH-Sampling is a frequency-aware hypergraph-driven oversampling method that captures high-order inter-sample relationships via hypergraphs while preserving spectral fidelity to mitigate majority-class bias in imbalanced time-series classification.
